notes.title: Second Patch
notes.content:
Thank you for your feedback. Here are the second patch notes.

[list]
[*] Made blocks less transparent
[*] Lowered "floatiness" of player movement
[*] Lowered backboard emissions
[*] Made it so that music and/or sound effects could be turned off
[/list]

tags.feature: [*] Made it so that music and/or sound effects could be turned off
